access: Only existing admitted reports, owned source packets and explicit whole-unit proposal fields. No images, reserves, new admission, target test, decoder, outside contact, GDT creation, global refresh, staging or commit. Prior exposure is retained; this is not blinded.
claim_ceiling: A construction offer for a previously authored whole reading, not new historical source evidence, a completed derivation, or a confirmed word. Review is required before selection.
title: RAW UNREVIEWED: written governors determine operation mode throughout the complete paired Galen account
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED. Keep GDT1029’s complete 95-group II/III hypothesis and its 67 assumed values, including the already paid qoky broadening. Replace no gloss. Ask whether a small written scope construction can derive BOIL as prohibited action, quoted rationale/name, planned stage and hypothetical prolonged action, rather than assigning modes by six discontinuous production IDs. This is a manual construction proposal, not another replay of its already tested worlds.

design.mechanism: Operation identity is stable while an overt governing construction determines whether it is asserted/prescribed, prohibited, mentioned as a rationale or name, or queried in a hypothetical/purpose frame. The same participant and water-reference roles pass through these scopes without creating a new executed event merely from an operation mention.
design.unit: Complete already owned f107v.45-49 (49 ZL groups, Galen II.44.2) plus f111r.44-47 (46 ZL groups, Galen II.44.3), all 95 positions of GDT1029 and their original diplomatic limits.
design.contrast: Written-governor scope shared across all occurrences versus mode assigned by spelling, adjacent repetition alone, or an occurrence-indexed list of N01-N06/C01-C05 semantic clauses.
design.prediction: The two adjacent BOIL tokens under CALLED belong to a designation, while the same lkeey under FOR belongs to a planned stage. The qokeey after BECAUSE belongs to the stated rationale and does not execute the prohibited action. The final reprise preserves the original two-stage instruction and its former/replacement water roles without allocating a third boil.
design.scope: Exploratory manual derivation within two already exposed complete units. No new historical source, lexical value, target fitting, decoder, capacity enumeration or event-world replay.

two_discriminating_consequences: One lkeey spelling appears in both the CALLED doublet and the FOR-purpose construction. A spelling-only mode rule cannot make it both an inert label and a planned stage. A single BOIL=event-name value with overt mode governors can in principle do so without changing the operation. This remains a proposed grammar, not a demonstrated derivation.

The II rationale must explain the already prohibited thorough boiling while the III AS_JUST_SAID clause resumes the old drying plan. If all operation mentions execute, the first creates the expressly forbidden action and the second attempts a further transfer from already abandoned former water. Proper scoping avoids both only if the same governing policy resolves written clauses and their water/food owners, rather than two ad hoc exceptions.

historical_operation.work: Galen, De alimentorum facultatibus II.44.2-3, complete local sections within the owned complete chapter II.44.1-5.
historical_operation.source_layer: Second-century work; owned Greek Helmreich CMG V4,2 (1923), pp311-313, and the dossier’s complete working translation. The 1277 medieval Latin transmission locator does not constitute a newly collated medieval target witness.
historical_operation.local_locator: II.44.2 two preparation purposes and retention rationale; II.44.3 names the twice-boiled preparation, extends it to other food kinds, warns against contact and explicitly resumes the former/replacement-water transfer.
historical_operation.owned_dependencies: Cook, desired use, food-kind, particular food portion, first water, replacement hot water, own juice, two ordered boiling stages, quoted name and prior instruction are distinct. A named procedure is reusable for another kind; that does not identify all physical portions.
historical_operation.limit: Source claims are historical explanations, not efficacy evidence. The quoted two-token target spelling is a target hypothesis; Greek has the named designation δίσεφθος. No word-for-word Greek alignment is asserted.

construction_offer: Retain BOIL as one operation denotation under both lkeey and qokeey, as already guessed. Do not infer modes from EVA l/q or make either prefix a quotation/imperative marker.

Propose a typed governor-complement construction: CALLED takes a prepared-food nominal and an operation-label sequence; FOR takes purpose content; BECAUSE links a mentioned action/proposition to its explanatory proposition. This is an offer to author exact surface scope, not an already sufficient parser.

The maximal contiguous BOIL run after CALLED is a concrete candidate naming boundary. It must stop at the next nonoperation expression, preserve two order slots and retain both foods as naming subjects. Generality beyond this single occurrence is unproved.

The shared rule must also distinguish mode from polarity and occurrence from type. A prohibition does not execute its action; the explanatory mention must retain the same prohibited content; a plan reprise cannot create another completed physical trace.

All crossing dependencies and suspensions must receive one written construction policy, including the intervening memory phrase and the late E18/E45 references. If the policy needs unexplained per-position skips, the whole account remains underived.
positive_basis: Directed formal composition and contextual effects are genuine baseline constraints. GDT1028/1029 already provide full hypothesized content and repeated operation denotations in several modes. Their execution agreement is a conditional consistency result, not evidence for the surface governors or a decoded grammar.
additional_assumptions: All 67 GDT1029 exact-form meanings remain fixed, including its explicitly broadened qoky; no claim of strict36 transfer.
Same food-type does not mean same physical portion; plan variables differ from a completed execution. D07/D19 already state this, so merely restating parameterization is not new.

The new claim to investigate is that written governor constructions determine the existing mode labels and their complete scope. The old clause-position lists are the authored outputs to be derived, not evidence that the grammar exists.
B16 about the not-losing-all intention remains optional and separately assumed; no mass, duration or actual retention outcome is added.
Existing 26 binding assumptions and all mode assignments remain costs until derived. This card has zero new values and zero demonstrated new derivations.
strongest_known_countercases: GDT1029 already has N02 quotation, N04 purpose, N05 hypothetical persistence and N06 plan reprise; replaying their old consequences is a duplicate. An offer must actually derive those scopes from written governors to add anything.
The same III unit has several discontinuous ownerships, especially THIS_USE at positions18/45 and water at44/46. A convenient local CALLED boundary alone does not complete the paragraph.

The original 49-group IT counterpart has six unknown forms; the new 47-group IT counterpart has o, okeeesey and cheom unbound, with oain split before the separately guessed ain. ZL che[o:?]m remains uncertain. RF has no matching whole record.
GDT1034 contradicts the broader common context-free word code over all four Galen inventories; this offer keeps only the existing II/III family and does not repair IV/V or add a contextual decoder.
The exposed ZL profiles have lkeey38/19selectors and qokeey280/70selectors; the local synonyms do not explain those wider distributions or prove a portable BOIL meaning.
W89 remains paused. Its role conflicts are not repaired by this distinct, already authored Galen family.
smallest_next_step: On paper, derive every BOIL/THOROUGH_REBOIL and every governing CALLED/FOR/BECAUSE/AS_JUST_SAID/HOWEVER_LONG occurrence from the two complete units using one written complement-and-scope policy; show actual operands, mode, polarity and food/water owner. Keep all 95 positions and the original other clauses. Start with the local CALLED sequence and the cross-boundary FULLY FULLY, then confront the discontinuous III scopes. Stop on an unlicensed exception. No event executor or new lexical inventory.

decision_note.unknown: Can actual shared written constructions replace the existing clause-ID mode selections without changing the full content?
decision_note.outcomes: A complete manual derivation would offer a smaller explicit whole-reading contract for review. Failure leaves the existing conditional interpretation and exact gap; it does not refute every Galen or cooking interpretation.
decision_note.minimum: One annotated whole-unit mode/argument inventory and a small explicitly written scope policy; no more invented worlds.
decision_note.future_budget: At most 25 minutes including review and documentation, only if root selects it.

novelty_boundary: Not a new source, operation, two-boil consequence, or parameterized-procedure discovery. The proposed new work is a lexical-governor derivation across multiple modes with fixed denotations, confronting the full existing discontinuous construction cost. Unreviewed derivative proposal.
